s1.desc: an igloo entryway with pale curved ice-block walls, an arched wooden front door and a round window

s2.desc: a bedroom drawn on a plain pale grey background

spans.view: with a small side table and a potted plant by the round window

beats.text: Polly hands a small striped lunch bag to Pax, who stands beside her holding a black briefcase
Pax takes the lunch bag and smiles at Polly with his eyes closed
Pax leans in and kisses Polly as a little heart floats up above them
Pax turns away, opens the door and waddles out through it while Polly watches him go

spans.notes: Camera locked, action clean, but the framed photo on the side table (left, by the window) shows Pax and Polly: a lead copy (D4), visible the whole shot. Small (about 70x90 px of 1080x1920). Dropped conservatively; the fields are filled in so the lead can flip keep if small background photos are judged acceptable.

spans.view: with a large yellow-framed bed with white sheets, a nightstand with a lamp, and a round window on the wall

beats.text: Polly flies in from the upper right, sailing belly-down through the air, and flops down onto the bed
Polly lies sprawled on her belly on the blanket, shuffling a little
Polly rolls over onto her back with a happy closed-eye smile
Polly tips over onto her side on the blanket
Polly rolls herself up in the blanket, leaving only the back of her head and her feet poking out
Polly pokes her head out of the rolled-up blanket and sits wrapped in it, rocking a little
Polly reaches out and picks up the tablet from the nightstand
Polly sits still wrapped in the blanket, holding the tablet up and staring at it

spans.view: with a large yellow-framed bed, a nightstand with a lamp, and a round window showing a crescent moon

beats.text: Pax stands at the foot of the bed holding his briefcase and looks over at Polly, who sits wrapped in the blanket with the tablet
Pax closes his eyes in a wide grin and crouches down
Pax springs up and leaps through the air toward Polly with his briefcase swinging behind him

spans.notes: The night scene is drawn with a steady darker grey tint over the whole room (night lighting, not changing in this span).

spans.view: with the head of the yellow bed, the nightstand lamp and a round window showing a crescent moon

beats.text: Pax drops out of the air and lands belly-down across Polly's lap
Pax lies belly-down across Polly's lap, facing away, while Polly keeps looking at the tablet
Polly lowers the tablet and looks down at Pax
Polly nestles her head down onto Pax with her eyes shut and a soft smile as a heart floats up
